name: bull_kelp
notes: Bull kelp: one bare whip of a stipe from the rock to the surface, a round float on top and long blades streaming from it along the surface. Grows only under 3 to 16 m of sea; height is the share of that depth (at high water) the stipe reaches; the rest of its length lies along the surface and gets longer as the tide goes out. Loose strands, not voxels, so swimmers pass through.
